name: Still
positioning: A fictional neighborhood coffee brand built around an unhurried daily ritual.
audience: People who enjoy carefully made coffee and a small pause in their day.

direction.tier: Editorial: photography, type and CSS motion. A neighborhood coffee brand needs warmth and speed more than spectacle.
devices: Plates: each chapter is catalogued like a still-life painting (Plate I, II, III) with a small caption line
Cobalt belongs to the cup: the accent colour appears in the interface only where the cup is the subject or the action
Voice line: one serif sentence under each display heading, never in body copy
invariants: One cup, one counter, one light
Chapter content model: plate label, message, one sentence, one image
variables: Crop and camera distance per plate
Which surface a section sits on

light.voiceFont: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

dark.voiceFont: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

imagery.subject: One cobalt ceramic cup with a thick rim and circular right-side handle
imagery.materials: Brushed stainless steel counter, glazed ceramic, roasted beans
imagery.lighting: Natural upper-left morning window light, soft rightward shadow
imagery.palette: Cool silver, cobalt blue, dark coffee; no warm beige backdrop
invariants: Same cup geometry and cobalt glaze
Same counter and cool gray background
Same light direction and restrained grain
avoid: Imagery presented as a real farm or cafe

motion.character: A short crossfade between plates of the same still life; the subject stays, the view moves closer. Native scrolling only.
motion.reducedMotion: All images and text in normal document flow, no pinning or animated transforms.

chapters.question: Where does the ritual start?
chapters.visual: Close study of roasted beans on the same steel counter; cobalt cup remains a recognizable background cue.
chapters.transition: Move closer to the material without changing the photographic world.

chapters.question: What changes the bean into the drink?
chapters.visual: Coffee pours into the same cobalt cup under the same window light.
chapters.transition: Crossfade to the action, preserving the cup and surface.
chapters.mobileFallback: Inline still photograph; no automatic playback.

chapters.question: How does it fit into a day?
chapters.message: Make room for the first sip.
chapters.visual: Finished cup, full shape visible with space around it.
chapters.transition: Return to the master image and resolve the visual story.
chapters.mobileFallback: Inline finished-cup image and reachable action.
